name: scad-view
description: Opens a browser tab that watches this project's folder and builds whichever .scad file you saved last — spin it, cut it open, measure it. Nothing is uploaded; the page reads the files off disk.

host.title: Scaid address
host.description: Where the viewer is hosted. Leave as is for the public one, or point it at http://localhost:3000 when working on the viewer itself.
